verdict.rationale: dlt explicitly supports switching destinations without changing pipeline code (docs-21), lists major warehouses/dialects including Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres and many SQL backends (docs-24, docs-33), and supports object storage/filesystem destinations like S3, GCS, Azure Blob (docs-39/53), all driven by the same declarative pipeline API. missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence naming Databricks as a supported destination, and independent/hands-on confirmation of pipeline portability across warehouses in production use.
